title: Wyze Sensor Reading Reading Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wyze:sensor reading_value=*
| stats sum(reading_value) as total_value, avg(reading_value) as avg_value by sensor_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sensor type values by total and average reading value across Wyze sensor reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reading_value` values for each Wyze sensor reading event and review total and average reading value by sensor type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reading value.
grandmaExplanation: It times which sensor type shows the biggest reading value numbers in your Wyze sensor reading data.
